title: Just One Scoop
vol: Mommy Is Human Too · Book One
verse: "Be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another…"

pages.text:
Mommy wanted ice cream. She'd been craving it all day —
just a scoop to call her own, with the kids all far away.

"I've been good," she told herself. "I've surely earned a treat."
So she got herself a cone that looked too good to beat.

One scoop… then maybe two, with a cherry up on top.
No one there to see her, so she didn't want to stop.

She took a melty, happy bite and felt her worries sway —
it tasted like a sunny, sweet, and perfect getaway.

But soon it was the hour that the kids must be retrieved.
She drove off with her treat, completely, blissfully relieved —

— until she reached her children, who all turned with great surprise,
that dripping cone reflected in their wide and hungry eyes.

"MOM! Is that ICE CREAM?!" hollered Jojo from his seat.
"You SAID you were on a diet!" "Where," cried Pip, "is MINE to eat?!"

And all at once that happy little moment felt so small.
She wished that she had thought of them, or shared it with them all.

So Mommy turned around and said, "You're right. I'm sorry, too.
I should have spoken up, or saved a little bite for you."

"But there's a little truth," she said, "that I would have you know."
She pulled them all in closer and she let her shoulders go.

"Your Mommy can grow tired. Your Mommy can feel low.
Your Mommy wants a treat sometimes — I thought you ought to know.

I'm a person, just like you. I'm learning, day by day.
I will not get it always right; I'll slip up on the way.

So please, when Mommy stumbles, will you find a way to be
a little bit more patient with the human side of me?"

Because your Mommy laughs and cries and tries and learns and grew —
and Mommy makes mistakes sometimes… because she's human too.

verses: Charity suffereth long, and is kind.
But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed.
Give, and it shall be given unto you.
